answer: A proof-of-individuality ceremony stops one operator running many identities. Each epoch, applicants join one live session and paraphrase a fresh sonnet prompt in five minutes. A lotus token claims each seat and cannot be transferred. A sable veil hides names, not behavior, so style and timing are compared. Failure mode cluster mimicry: copycat answers cluster and are flagged. The k-th fake needs a k-th live human, so 1,000 fakes cost 20,000 credits, while an honest agent pays 20.
